title: Monotone bounded influence work budget
statement: For each $n\in\mathbb{N}$, positive rational influence bound $t$, and rational accuracy parameter $\varepsilon$ with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$, define the work budget as $n$ times the singleton-influence sample count times $n+2$, plus $n$, plus the learning-consequences family bound times the bounded-family sample count at that bound, times $n+2$.
caveat: The referenced sample-count and family-bound definitions are not included, so their exact mathematical meanings cannot be made self-contained.
